description: Moving Traffic Enforcement - Enforcement Points - 2023 is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. Leicester City Council operates a bus lane enforcement scheme to improve public transport reliability, journey times and to encourage sustainable travel. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under City and Governance. Its keywords are Bus Lane, enforcement. The portal shows 26 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-05-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
